metadata.name: Veil & Vow
metadata.author: HeistMind E2E
metadata.description: A quiet game of haunted oaths and borrowed power. Minimal ruleset: no custom steps, no point-buy, untiered powers. (Original FitD-style test ruleset.)

playbooks.name: The Seer
playbooks.description: One who reads the veil and trades in glimpsed futures.

playbooks.name: The Warden
playbooks.description: A sworn protector bound by an oath they can never break.

contacts.name: Sister Quill
contacts.description: An oathkeeper of the old order.

attributes.name: Mind
attributes.description: Reason, memory, and the reading of signs.

attributes.name: Spirit
attributes.description: Will, faith, and communion with the veil.

specialAbilities.name: Foresight
specialAbilities.description: Once per score, ask the GM one true thing about what is to come.

specialAbilities.name: Ward
specialAbilities.description: Raise a brief barrier against harm, mundane or otherwise.

specialAbilities.name: Echo
specialAbilities.description: Hear the last words spoken in a place you stand.
